propositions: The host updater installs dependencies via unlocked pipx VCS resolution, bypassing the committed uv.lock and Click security override
The updater must resolve to an exact SHA from git ls-remote and perform uv sync --locked with runtime/operator extras, never modifying repository pyproject.toml or uv.lock
Failed sync or smoke-test steps must log rejection reason, exit nonzero, and leave the current installation byte-identical
The updater must manage versioned release directories atomically and retain only the published release after successful installation
Published runtime must declare Click 8.4.2 with no PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability and pass pip-audit cleanly
Symlinks rebar, rebar-mcp, and last-good.sha must resolve through current into the exact-SHA release, with launchd-triggered updates verifying idempotence on repeat runs
